Unify APIs, data transfer, and integration across your enterprise

Securely connect legacy systems, partners, and modern digital services without disrupting what
already works.

[Explore Products][112]
[Unify APIs, data transfer, and integration across your enterprise]

## A trusted choice for some of the world’s top brands

[Axway Customer: Bosch]
[Axway Customer: Cenora]
[Axway Customer: eNGie]
[Axway Customer: PermataBank]
[Axway Customer: NOV]

[Axway Customer: DB Schenker]

## Solve your most critical integration challenges

#### Modernize legacy systems

Upgrade outdated systems without disrupting business operations.

#### Secure partner data exchange

Simplify and standardize how you exchange data with suppliers, vendors, and partners

#### Govern APIs at scale

Bring visibility, control, and scalability to your growing API ecosystem

#### Secure and govern AI

Track, audit, and ensure AI projects governance for every AI interaction

# Enterprise integration designed for a modern world

Connect systems, data, and partners across cloud and on-premises environments without ripping and
replacing.

[card_deck_media]

#### Amplify

Bring API-first, AI-ready services to market faster

[Explore Amplify][113]
[card_deck_media]

#### Managed File Transfer

Move data securely and reliably at enterprise scale

[Learn About MFT][114]
[card_deck_media]

#### B2B Integration

Bridge traditional EDI and new integration patterns

[See B2B Integration][115]
[card_deck_media]

#### Financial Accounting Hub

Centralize accounting rules to ensure accuracy and compliance

[Explore Our Finance Solutions][116]

### Reinventing Integration for the AI Era

With intelligent automation and real-time orchestration, Amplify Fusion helps you cut complexity,
deliver connected experiences faster, and sale AI workflows confidently. 

[Explore Fusion][117]

## Built for the demands of regulated industries

When compliance, security, and reliability are non-negotiable, leading organizations choose Axway. 

[Banking Financial Services]

#### Banking and Financial Services

Gain the advantages of open banking with an API-first approach that unleashes the value of your
digital ecosystem to create new services and expand markets

[Learn More][118]
[Healthcare]

#### Healthcare

Reach further into the healthcare ecosystem and improve patient engagement with an API management
platform that meets all critical healthcare standards and regulations

[Learn More][119]
[Government]

#### Government

Manage and safeguard public data across the government agency ecosystem on-premises or in any cloud
environment with an open API management platform and API-powered B2B/EDI and MFT

[Learn More][120]

## We're a recognized industry leader

When you need to validate your digital integration product decisions, look to see what the most
respected industry analysts are saying.

**A Leader** in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide API Management 2026

[Read Excerpt][121]

**A Leader** in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for API Management for the 10th time

[Read the Gartner Report][122]

**A Leader** in The Forrester Wave™: API Management Software, Q3 2024.

[Read the Press Release][123]

**Consistent Leader** for Amplify API Management Platform, Managed File Transfer, and B2B
Integration.

[Learn More][124]

## Customer success stories

Discover how Axway has transformed business like yours.

MANAGED FILE TRANSFER

#### Dun & Bradstreet fosters innovation with secure data sharing

It would be impossible to provide our services and meet our regulatory obligations without a
solution like Axway SecureTransport. Whether we’re moving a few dozen records or transferring 100
million of them, we need to know we can trust our MFT systems to be reliable and secure.

– Jim Martone, VP Engineering at Dun & Bradstreet
[See Case Studies][125]
API MANAGEMENT

#### Smals reduces costs, improves efficiencies and spurs innovation

With Axway, we can expose the same functionalities and interfaces while modernizing the way we
manage and virtualize APIs internally. It was crucial to perform the migrations in a controlled way
because many of our clients rely on APIs to deliver mission-critical services. We transparently
migrated our legacy services to Amplify API Management with zero disruption for end users.

– Willem Salembier, Solution Architect at Smals
[See Case Studies][126]
B2B INTEGRATION

#### Cencora drives multibillion-dollar operations with ultra-reliable EDI integration

"Crucially, the Axway platform is extremely reliable. We have deployed Axway B2Bi across two
active/active data centers, enabling us to perform maintenance and upgrade work on one site while
the other remains active. This ensures we can offer EDI services to our stakeholders 24/7."

– Scott Marshall, Senior Director, IT Product Lead – EDI Technology at Cencora
[See Case Studies][127]

## It's the end of Integromat

**But it's only the beginning of the no-code era.**

When we launched Integromat in 2016, it brought the radical promise of connecting hundreds of
applications in a unique and visual way. We're incredibly proud that thousands of you saw this
potential, and embraced Integromat to do things we could never even imagine.

As our community of users grew, so did the capability of our platform. In 2022, we announced that
Integromat would evolve to Make. Expanding on our original, radical promise, we set out to provide a
visual automation platform for businesses of all sizes.

So as Integromat shuts down and we close this first chapter of our story, we're incredibly excited
to see what you - and the whole community - will create with Make.

Made with 💜 in Prague.

# Architect to win the agent age.

MuleSoft is your one single enterprise agent control plane to discover and unify every agent, app,
API, and MCP server. Then, build reliable multi-step experiences that span agents, tools, and your
business apps while tracking and controlling your token cost spend.

Watch Demo [ Talk to an expert ][2]

## Explore MuleSoft’s latest innovations.

Dive deeper into additional feature [releases and updates][3].

[ [An image showing the MuleSoft Agent Fabric logo] ][4]

### MuleSoft Agent Fabric

Intelligently govern and orchestrate every AI agent regardless of where it’s built. Maximize ROI,
ensure compliance, and continuously improve agent performance.

[ Learn more ][5]
[ [Govern every AI interaction from a single control plane.] ][6]

### MuleSoft Omni Gateway

Govern every API, agent, and model across your existing gateways, from development through
deployment, from a single control plane.

[ Learn more ][7]
[ [An image showing the Trusted Agent Identity logo.] ][8]

### Trusted Agent Identity

AI agents introduce new security and identity challenges. Ensure agents can securely and responsibly
interact with downstream services on behalf of users.

[ Learn more ][9]
[ [An image showing the MuleSoft Agent Scanners logo.] ][10]

### MuleSoft Agent Scanners

Automatically discover AI agents across your organization to gain visibility over your Agentic
Enterprise. Find agents from Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and other agent platforms and
register them in one place.

[ Learn more ][11]
[Infographic showing MuleSoft's unified platform capabilities]

## Accelerate your agentic transformation.

In the agentic era, the fastest enterprises are those that treat governance as an accelerant, not a
hurdle. MuleSoft enables every team to connect, orchestrate, and manage AI interactions with
built-in governance from day one, so you can deploy at scale with total confidence.

[ Start with Anypoint Platform ][12]

### Build on what you already own.

Turn years of existing assets into governed MCP tools agents can discover and act on.

### Govern every interaction from day one.

Apply consistent security, cost controls, and compliance policies across every agent, model, and API
call.

### Orchestrate agents across ecosystems.

Enable your agents to achieve complex goals across environments with guided determinism.

### See everything and trust what’s running.

Achieve comprehensive observability across all your APIs and agents from a single control plane.

## Meet the unified platform to govern and orchestrate your multi-agent enterprise.

Govern your multi-agent ecosystem. Orchestrate agent action. Build your open agent foundation,
faster. Build your open agent foundation, faster.

## Govern and manage your multi-agent ecosystem.

### [ MuleSoft Omni Gateway ][13]

Govern every interaction between AI, agents, APIs and your systems - with a fast, flexible gateway
built to work across any environment.

[ Learn more ][14]

### [ MuleSoft Agent Visualizer ][15]

Visualize, monitor, and optimize your entire agent network with a real-time map of every
interaction.

[ Learn more ][16]

### [ Anypoint API Manager ][17]

Manage all your APIs, microservices, and AI agent interactions from a single control plane.

[ Learn more ][18]

### [ Anypoint API Governance ][19]

Gain consistent API security and quality without sacrificing development speed.

[ Learn more ][20]

### [ Anypoint Monitoring ][21]

Monitor, diagnose, and troubleshoot your operations comprehensively.

[ Learn more ][22]

## Discover and orchestrate any agent.

### [ MuleSoft Agent Registry ][23]

Catalog every agent, tool, and asset into a single, governed registry to stop shadow AI.

[ Learn more ][24]

### [ MuleSoft Agent Scanners ][25]

Automatically discover agents across major AI platforms and catalog them in MuleSoft Agent Registry.

[ Learn more ][26]

### [ MuleSoft Agent Broker ][27]

Orchestrate complex processes with your choice of determinism. Define fixed rules for trusted
hand-offs and dynamically route tasks to the best-fit agent.

[ Learn more ][28]

### [ MuleSoft A2A Support ][29]

Enable seamless multi-agent collaboration across your enterprise.

[ Learn more ][30]

## Connect to any AI, app, system, or data.

### [ Anypoint Connectors ][31]

Integrate systems faster with hundreds of prebuilt connectors.

[ Learn more ][32]

### [ MuleSoft MCP Support ][33]

Transform any application or API into tools and resources for AI agents.

[ Learn more ][34]

### [ MuleSoft IDP ][35]

Transform manual data retrieval into streamlined, automated workflows.

[ Learn more ][36]

### [ Anypoint Partner Manager ][37]

Speed up partner onboarding and adopt new technologies without disrupting existing transactions.

[ Learn more ][38]

## Develop with natural language, clicks, or code.

### [ MuleSoft Vibes ][39]

Build APIs and integrations completely through natural language

Backed by 25 years of continuous modernization, TIBCO’s real-time, AI-enabled composable platform
connects your enterprise, amplifying its intelligence for smarter, faster decisions.

## INTELLIGENT AUTOMATION

  without heavy development, TIBCO provides a unified [AI platform][38].

  integrated vector databases and advanced analytics, TIBCO transforms raw data into actionable
  intelligence.

  innovation. TIBCO enables business users and developers to build powerful, intelligent
  applications helping to democratize AI.

  palette. With these advanced AI accelerators, TIBCO helps to fast-track development, reduce

# cPanel & WHM Developer Portal

cPanel & WHM offers many customization options for server administrators and third-party developers.
Our APIs and other integration systems offer the tools to successfully build a custom application
that works seamlessly with cPanel or WHM.

[

### Get started with WHM

System administrators use WHM to perform server administration functions:
* Create, manage, and monitor cPanel accounts.
* Configure networking information.
* Manage SSL certificates.
* Monitor and restart services.

][7][

### Get started with cPanel

Website owners use cPanel to perform website management functions:
* Manage individual domains.
* Create and manage email (including Webmail) and FTP accounts.
* Create and manage databases.

][8]

The API function documentation on this site applies to cPanel & WHM version 136. Some API functions
may not exist in older cPanel & WHM versions.
* Visit our legacy [Developer Documentation][9] to find additional information about our deprecated
  API systems.
* For more information about Manage2 APIs, read our [Manage2 API][10] documentation.
* To learn more about how to integrate into cPanel & WHM, read our [Guides and Tutorials][11].

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying

focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

⟶][127]

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

⟶][127]

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

# MOVING IN UNISON

We work as a flexible, attentive extension of your team; we offer the contract research organization
services you need to move your molecule from preclinical to Phase I, Phase II, and beyond.

[ Contact Us ][14]

[play brand video ][15] [pause brand video ][16]
[5 Strategies to Reduce AI Hallucination in Clinical Research by Seong min Cho]

#### 5 Strategies to Reduce AI Hallucination in Clinical Research by Seong min Cho

Learn 5 practical strategies to reduce AI hallucination in clinical research to improve accuracy,
transparency, compliance, and decision-making.

[Read now! ][17]

[A Day in the Life of A Molecule]

#### A Day in the Life of A Molecule

Press play to meet Mike the Molecule—he’s got big dreams and a big journey ahead! Follow along as he
takes on every stage of drug development here at Altasciences.Science has never been this fun!

[Learn more! ][18]

[A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology]

#### A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

## WHAT WE DO

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.
* [ [Preclinical Services] ][20]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Preclinical Services ][21]
  
  Safety assessments for both small and large molecules
* [ [Clinical Services] ][22]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Clinical Services ][23]
  
  Clinical pharmacology trials from first-in-human to end of Phase II
* [ [Manufacturing and Analytical Services] ][24]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Manufacturing and Analytical Services ][25]
  
  From formulation development, Phase I through commercial manufacturing, and ICH stability testing
* [ [thumb] ][26]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Bioanalysis Services ][27]
  
  Package or stand-alone. Preclinical, Phase I to Phase IV bioanalytical laboratories
* [ [research support services] ][28]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Research Support Services ][29]
  
  Comprehensive CRO services to support clinical and preclinical studies

transparency, compliance, and decision-making.

[Read now! ][17]

[A Day in the Life of A Molecule]

#### A Day in the Life of A Molecule

Press play to meet Mike the Molecule—he’s got big dreams and a big journey ahead! Follow along as he
takes on every stage of drug development here at Altasciences.Science has never been this fun!

[Learn more! ][18]

[A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology]

#### A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

## WHAT WE DO

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.
* [ [Preclinical Services] ][20]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Preclinical Services ][21]
  
  Safety assessments for both small and large molecules
* [ [Clinical Services] ][22]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Clinical Services ][23]
  
  Clinical pharmacology trials from first-in-human to end of Phase II
* [ [Manufacturing and Analytical Services] ][24]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Manufacturing and Analytical Services ][25]
  
  From formulation development, Phase I through commercial manufacturing, and ICH stability testing
* [ [thumb] ][26]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Bioanalysis Services ][27]
  
  Package or stand-alone. Preclinical, Phase I to Phase IV bioanalytical laboratories
* [ [research support services] ][28]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Research Support Services ][29]
  
  Comprehensive CRO services to support clinical and preclinical studies

Energy Security Framework Gas Prices Explained Permitting Reform American Energy Snapshot

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

[Learn More][36]
[Download The Framework][37]
[AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK]

### **Gas Prices Explained**

Gas prices get a lot of attention, but they’re driven by a complex set of global factors, with crude
oil markets playing the central role. This explainer puts those dynamics into context and breaks
down what’s behind the numbers at the pump.

[Read More][38]
[Gas Prices Explained]

### **America Builds. America wins.**

Building new infrastructure allows energy to flow faster and more easily which could make energy
more affordable for consumers.

[Learn More][39]
[America Builds. America wins.]

American energy is a cornerstone of economic strength, national security and global stability. This
dashboard updates in real-time as new data becomes available, and tracks key metrics on U.S. energy
production, prices and trade.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Follow us and keep up to date

[about]

APMIDA Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. manufacturing Bulk Drug API derived from various chemicals which
have a growing demand globally. The company is linked with developed pieces of equipment of the
technology and machinery for the process of the manufacturing of the Medicine product. The state of
the art manufacturing is Drug licensed and GMP and ISO certifications. Along with this, our
production place has the following amenities:
* #### We have vast and spacious warehouse in excise free zones to do the other activities of the
  #### manufacturing of the drugs.
* #### Quality control Lab and Analytical Testing along with R&D Manufacturing facilities
* #### State Drug licenses
* #### FDA Registered

### We are Helping to Advance Health with Clinical Trials for Medicine.

APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. is a vertically integrated company that develops, manufactures, and
sells Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), High Potency API, and API intermediates. Our unique
research and synthesis facility reflects our commitment to research and innovation. The world-class
manufacturing facilities at APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. are located in Dist. Rampur (UP)India.
These facilities are benchmarked to international standards and set to meet the rigorous quality
guideline, which is critical in achieving our global growth aspirations.

As a leading API supplier, our regulatory-approved facilities enable us to supply our partners all
over countries with a broad portfolio of products. Our expertise spans a variety of chemical
processes, Heterocyclic chemistry, Carbohydrates chemistry. Additionally, we manage enzyme
conversions for some of our products. Our manufacturing capacity for various categories ranges from
500MT/year to 800MT/Year.

# Driving partner success with reliable, expert-driven CDMO services

At Bora Pharmaceuticals, it is our shared responsibility to execute every drug program reliably on
time, consistently in full.

[ Get in touch today ][54]

## A global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner
* From sites in North America and Asia, Bora delivers reliable, high-quality drug products to 100+
  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical
products.

From our nine cGMP facilities across three countries, Bora Pharmaceuticals delivers drug products
with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

Working for a Safer Drug Supply Chain

The Bulk Pharmaceuticals Task Force (BPTF) is an industry trade organization representing
manufacturers of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), intermediates and excipients. BPTF
addresses regulatory and quality issues related to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP)
compliance. 

 

 

[Prescription Drugs]
[[Bar Chart]][11]
[[FDA-White-Oak-Building-01.jpg]][12]
[[Business Brainstorm]][13]

Quality Performance

BPTF is focused on quality throughout the supply chain. Creating a quality culture in manufacturing
requires dilligence and a need to keep informed and aware of ever-changing regulatory guidance
and industry standards.

 

Engaged

BPTF is a key stakeholder in negotiations with FDA on authorization of the Generic Drug User Fee
Amendments (GDUFA) and works with an array of industry trade groups to stay abreast of all
developments in the drug industry.

Advocacy

BPTF is a trusted industry voice respected within the drug supply chain and trusted by influential
leaders working on supply chain safety.

CARBOGEN AMCIS, a Switzerland-based pharmaceutical process development and Active Pharmaceutical
Ingredient (API) manufacturing company, has suc-cessfully commissioned a new ground-mounted
photovoltaic system at its Hunzenschwil site in Switzerland. With this project, the company
underscores its long-term commitment to sustainability and the expansion of renewable energy.

[Owen McCarthy]

Owen McCarthy

Reviewer

Owen McCarthy has had a long love affair with all things technical since the dawn of the computer
age. A child of the 1960’s, he agrees with legendary author, Douglas Adams, that digital watches
were a pretty neat idea. By the 1980’s Owen was learning how to code using C and by the turn of the
century, he was teaching HTML to enthusiastic youngsters. These days, Owen can be found pestering
editors for new technology to review on an annoyingly regular basis. In his spare time, he rides
motorcycles of the three-wheeled variety, studies theology, aqua-jogs, and works hard to honour his
late wife’s request to live a joy-filled life.

[Sean Mitchell]

Sean Mitchell

Publisher

Having started his career at Renaissance. Sean joined Apple in Melbourne for a number of years
before working in the media space. This started with Review Publishing and later the tech publisher
IDG Communications. In 2006 he was involved in the launch of The Channel magazine. As they say – the
rest is history.

[Sofiah Nichole Salivio]

Sofiah Nichole Salivio

News Editor

Sofiah Nichole has balanced a dual passion for technical precision and the written word since 2017.
Before diving into the world of Civil Engineering, she spent years navigating school press
conferences and contributing to university publications, honing her skills as a versatile staff
writer. Outside of her engineering labs, you can find her advocating for student voices and looking
for the next great story to tell. She believes that whether you are building a bridge or a news
report, the foundation must be rock solid.

[Tom Richmond]

Tom Richmond

Reviewer

Originally from the Isle of Man, Tom has been contributing for Techday for a number of years. He
loves sport, tech and cars. In his spare time, you’ll either find him on the golf course, playing
football or test-driving a new car.

[Anthony Caruana]

Anthony Caruana

Interview Editor

Anthony has been living and breathing technology since he was a child. He has contributed to almost
every major technology publication in Australia as well as editing a few along the way. In his spare
time, he likes to run, especially on trails, and plays Australian Rules football through the winter.

[Damian Seeto]

Damian Seeto

Gaming Contributor

Damian has been contributing for Techday since 2009 and is always available whenever a video game
needs to be reviewed. Aside from being a big gamer, he is also one of biggest professional wrestling
fans. Damian likes Star Wars, comic book movies and Metallica.

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a

By the time it lands, it's old.

Entrepreneur India is a monthly magazine published by Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS),
aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the most suitable project for investment. It makes
business decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a carefully curated list of the right
projects for investment. Unique among project investment magazines, Entrepreneur India is entirely
dedicated to the business of identifying sound investment projects. Every issue consists of a new
list of ventures that are meticulously selected by the NPCS team after rigorous screening on
multiple investment factors — ensuring that each project recommendation is grounded in real market
opportunity and financial viability.

## Frequently asked questions

Find quick answers to common queries.

[Get Support][15]

### Is eSIM good for travel?

Absolutely! eSIM is fantastic for travel. It lets you hop from one country to another without the
hassle of swapping SIM cards. Plus, you get to enjoy local data rates!

### Which eSIM is best for Travelling?

eSIMCard is an excellent choice for travelers. It offers global, regional, and local eSIM options so
that you can stay connected almost anywhere in the world.

### Can you install eSIM before Travelling?

Yes, you can! Setting up your eSIMCard before you start your journey is super easy. Just scan a QR
code or enter the activation code provided by email, and you're all set to go.

### Can I use eSIM in any country?

eSIMCard has got you covered in nearly every corner of the globe, with coverage in over 200+
countries. While most countries support eSIM, checking if your destination is on the list is always
good.

### Which devices are eSIM Compatible?

Many modern devices are eSIM compatible. This includes the latest iPhone series, Samsung Galaxy S20
to S23, Google Pixel 4 and later, and even some iPads. Check the list of all eSIM-supported devices.

### How do I know if my eSIM is active?

Once you've installed your eSIMCard, you can check your device's network settings. You're good to go
if it shows the network name and you've got signal bars!

### What countries don't accept eSIM?

While eSIM is widely accepted, a few places might still be catching up. Like use of eSIM in India
and Russia is not common. It's best to check eSIMCard's country list on our website or app for the
latest info.

## Frequently asked questions

Find quick answers to common queries.

[Get Support][15]

### Is eSIM good for travel?

Absolutely! eSIM is fantastic for travel. It lets you hop from one country to another without the
hassle of swapping SIM cards. Plus, you get to enjoy local data rates!

### Which eSIM is best for Travelling?

eSIMCard is an excellent choice for travelers. It offers global, regional, and local eSIM options so
that you can stay connected almost anywhere in the world.

### Can you install eSIM before Travelling?

Yes, you can! Setting up your eSIMCard before you start your journey is super easy. Just scan a QR
code or enter the activation code provided by email, and you're all set to go.

### Can I use eSIM in any country?

eSIMCard has got you covered in nearly every corner of the globe, with coverage in over 200+
countries. While most countries support eSIM, checking if your destination is on the list is always
good.

### Which devices are eSIM Compatible?

Many modern devices are eSIM compatible. This includes the latest iPhone series, Samsung Galaxy S20
to S23, Google Pixel 4 and later, and even some iPads. Check the list of all eSIM-supported devices.

### How do I know if my eSIM is active?

Once you've installed your eSIMCard, you can check your device's network settings. You're good to go
if it shows the network name and you've got signal bars!

### What countries don't accept eSIM?

While eSIM is widely accepted, a few places might still be catching up. Like use of eSIM in India
and Russia is not common. It's best to check eSIMCard's country list on our website or app for the
latest info.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are

  ### Having presence in 65+ countries

  ### Backwardly integrated for PAP
* [icon]
  
  ### Forward integration for DC
* [icon]
  
  ### Only Paracetamol Manufacturer with RC Logo (2023)
* [icon]
  
  ### 23% Global Market Share in API Paracetamol
* [icon]
  
  ### 40% Domestic India Market Share in Paracetamol API

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

### Paracetamol DC Granules – Directly Compressible for Tablet Production

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

### New APIs – Theophylline, Rivaroxaban, Folic Acid & More

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

### Caffeine Anhydrous API

EU GMP Certified, 600 MT/Month

# Discover the Google Analytics platform

[GA partners logo]

## About This Site

**Google Analytics Demos & Tools** is a resource for users and developers to discover what's
possible with the Google Analytics Platform. Learn how to implement GA and applications that can be
built to take advantage of the flexibility and power of Google Analytics.

The code for this entire site is open source and [available on GitHub][13]. We encourage you to take
a look if you'd like to see how anything is done.

### Demos

Live demos to help you learn about Google Analytics features.
* Working demos with actual data sent to Google Analytics.
* Use these demos as a reference for your own implementation.
* Interactive elements that provide implementation code snippets.

### Tools

Tools to showcase how Google Analytics can be extended with custom solutions.
* Tools are targeted at real-world use cases and solutions.
* Access advanced Google Analytics features without writing any code.
* All publicly available technologies are used. Nothing proprietary.

## Help & Feedback

### For this site
* Fill out a [brief customer survey][14] and let us know what you think!
* You may report bugs by [submitting an issue][15] on GitHub.
* You may also use GitHub to [request a new demo or tool][16].

### For the Google Analytics platform
* Documentation for all Google Analytics API, libraries and SDKs can be found on [Google Analytics
  Developers][17].
* If you have questions, please refer to the [getting help][18] section of the developers site to
  find the best place to get your questions answered.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

06.07.2026

[Revised Annex 19 on Reference and Retention Samples][189]

The European Commission has published a revised version of Annex 19 of EudraLex Volume 4, allowing
photographic or digital records as an alternative to physical retention samples for parallel traded
products. The new version is applicable from 24 September 2026.

[Read more][190]

06.07.2026

[How to (not) use AI for GxP Inspection Responses][191]

In a recent blog post, the U.K. MHRA has outlined examples of responses to inspection reports that
were generated by artificial intelligence (AI), which, in some cases, contain alarming errors.

[Read more][192]

06.07.2026

[Q&As on "GMP meets AI - How to Use Artificial Intelligence in Quality Assurance and Quality
Control"][193]

In February, more than 80 people participated in the Live Online Training organized by the ECA on
the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Quality Assurance and Quality Control. During the Q&A
sessions, numerous interesting questions were asked, which were answered by the presenters. We have
compiled a selection of these questions and answers for you.

## GMP News

06.07.2026

[Revised Annex 19 on Reference and Retention Samples][189]

The European Commission has published a revised version of Annex 19 of EudraLex Volume 4, allowing
photographic or digital records as an alternative to physical retention samples for parallel traded
products. The new version is applicable from 24 September 2026.

[Read more][190]

06.07.2026

[How to (not) use AI for GxP Inspection Responses][191]

In a recent blog post, the U.K. MHRA has outlined examples of responses to inspection reports that
were generated by artificial intelligence (AI), which, in some cases, contain alarming errors.

[Read more][192]

06.07.2026

[Q&As on "GMP meets AI - How to Use Artificial Intelligence in Quality Assurance and Quality
Control"][193]

In February, more than 80 people participated in the Live Online Training organized by the ECA on
the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Quality Assurance and Quality Control. During the Q&A
sessions, numerous interesting questions were asked, which were answered by the presenters. We have
compiled a selection of these questions and answers for you.

[Read more][194]

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

# Your Global Bridge to Critical Medicines

As a trusted pharmaceutical supplier since 2003, GNH India bridges the gap between the world's most
critical medicines and the patients and institutions who need them. From named patient supply and
orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver
with regulatory precision, cold chain integrity, and a commitment to access that goes beyond
borders.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.

  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.

compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of

GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.
