# About Us

With over 45 years of experience, Moravek is a leading provider of high-quality carbon-14 and
tritium labeled compounds to researchers worldwide and is one of the most trusted contract
development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs) offering radiosynthesis services. Moravek
specializes in the custom production of GMP carbon-14 labeled active pharmaceutical ingredients
(APIs) that are manufactured compliant with U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) guidance ICH Q7
Section 19 and are suitable for use in early phase clinical trials. Moravek also offers non-GMP
custom synthesis services and an extensive catalog of non-GLP radiolabeled, stable-labeled, and
non-labeled compounds.

[Learn More][27][Laboratory 6]
GMP Carbon-14 Labeled APIs
Custom Non-GMP Isotopically Labeled Compounds
[X-Ray Diffraction image]

## GMP Carbon-14 Labeled APIs

Moravek’s team is highly experienced in the custom synthesis, purification, analysis, and release of
GMP carbon-14 labeled APIs for use in early phase clinical trials. We have successfully prepared
over one hundred GMP carbon-14 labeled APIs for many leading pharmaceutical companies and research
institutions. With our knowledgeable radiochemists, proactive project managers, and experienced
Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams, Moravek has the expertise and capacity to supply custom
carbon-14 labeled APIs that consistently meet regulatory requirements and are on time for your
clinical trial.

[See more about GMP 14C-labeled compounds][28]
[Laboratory]

## Custom Non-GMP Isotopically Labeled Compounds

Moravek routinely carries out custom manufacturing of non-GMP compounds labeled with radioisotopes
(carbon-14 and tritium) as well as compounds labeled with stable isotopes (primarily carbon-13,
deuterium, and nitrogen-15). Our chemists are proficient in a wide variety of synthetic techniques
and are able to prepare nearly any compound, including all U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration
(DEA) Schedule I – V controlled substances. Once the synthesis is complete, our talented
purification and analytical chemists will ensure that your compound meets agreed-upon
specifications.

Learn more about [Radiolabeling][29] or [Organic Synthesis][30]

## Non-GLP Catalog Items

Moravek offers an extensive selection of radiolabeled, stable-labeled, and non-labeled compounds,
such as nucleosides, nucleotides, amino acids, antivirals, and anticancer compounds. A variety of
isotopes and label positions are available to suit many of your research needs.

[Browse Our Catalog][31]

## Quality System

Moravek’s rigorous Quality System is compliant with ICH Q7 Section 19, which has been adopted by
regulatory agencies including the FDA and provides guidance regarding good manufacturing practices
for the production of APIs for use in early phase clinical trials.

We welcome Quality Assurance audits of our facilities.

[Learn More][32]

## Certifications and Licenses

Moravek manufactures GMP carbon-14 labeled APIs under a Drug Manufacturing License issued by the
California Department of Public Health – Food and Drug Branch following an audit of our Quality
System. GMP production is carried out in one of four cleanrooms which are annually certified to be
ISO Class 7 compliant. Moravek also has a license from the DEA to handle the full range of Schedule
I – V controlled substances.

[Learn More][33]

# About Us

With over 45 years of experience, Moravek is a leading provider of high-quality carbon-14 and
tritium labeled compounds to researchers worldwide and is one of the most trusted contract
development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs) offering radiosynthesis services. Moravek
specializes in the custom production of GMP carbon-14 labeled active pharmaceutical ingredients
(APIs) that are manufactured compliant with U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) guidance ICH Q7
Section 19 and are suitable for use in early phase clinical trials. Moravek also offers non-GMP
custom synthesis services and an extensive catalog of non-GLP radiolabeled, stable-labeled, and
non-labeled compounds.

[Learn More][27][Laboratory 6]
GMP Carbon-14 Labeled APIs
Custom Non-GMP Isotopically Labeled Compounds
[X-Ray Diffraction image]

## GMP Carbon-14 Labeled APIs

Moravek’s team is highly experienced in the custom synthesis, purification, analysis, and release of
GMP carbon-14 labeled APIs for use in early phase clinical trials. We have successfully prepared
over one hundred GMP carbon-14 labeled APIs for many leading pharmaceutical companies and research
institutions. With our knowledgeable radiochemists, proactive project managers, and experienced
Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams, Moravek has the expertise and capacity to supply custom
carbon-14 labeled APIs that consistently meet regulatory requirements and are on time for your
clinical trial.

[See more about GMP 14C-labeled compounds][28]
[Laboratory]

## Custom Non-GMP Isotopically Labeled Compounds

Moravek routinely carries out custom manufacturing of non-GMP compounds labeled with radioisotopes
(carbon-14 and tritium) as well as compounds labeled with stable isotopes (primarily carbon-13,
deuterium, and nitrogen-15). Our chemists are proficient in a wide variety of synthetic techniques
and are able to prepare nearly any compound, including all U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration
(DEA) Schedule I – V controlled substances. Once the synthesis is complete, our talented
purification and analytical chemists will ensure that your compound meets agreed-upon
specifications.

Learn more about [Radiolabeling][29] or [Organic Synthesis][30]

## Non-GLP Catalog Items

Moravek offers an extensive selection of radiolabeled, stable-labeled, and non-labeled compounds,
such as nucleosides, nucleotides, amino acids, antivirals, and anticancer compounds. A variety of
isotopes and label positions are available to suit many of your research needs.

[Browse Our Catalog][31]

## Quality System

Moravek’s rigorous Quality System is compliant with ICH Q7 Section 19, which has been adopted by
regulatory agencies including the FDA and provides guidance regarding good manufacturing practices
for the production of APIs for use in early phase clinical trials.

We welcome Quality Assurance audits of our facilities.

[Learn More][32]

## Certifications and Licenses

Moravek manufactures GMP carbon-14 labeled APIs under a Drug Manufacturing License issued by the
California Department of Public Health – Food and Drug Branch following an audit of our Quality
System. GMP production is carried out in one of four cleanrooms which are annually certified to be
ISO Class 7 compliant. Moravek also has a license from the DEA to handle the full range of Schedule
I – V controlled substances.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

##### [ Internal Medicine ][109]

[ View All Internal Medicine ][110]

We’re developing therapies to treat, slow, or prevent disease progression and improve the quality of
life for patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular and kidney diseases. 

[Inflammation and Immunology graphical thumbnail portrait image 3]

##### [ Inflammation & Immunology ][111]

[ View All Inflammation & Immunology ][112]

We look for treatments that provide more than just symptom relief, in order to address the root
cause of chronic inflammatory diseases at a molecular level

[Vaccine graphical thumbnail portrait image 4]

##### [ Vaccines ][113]

[ View All Vaccines ][114]

Vaccines are the single most important innovation in the science of health to significantly reduce
the threat of diseases that were once widespread and oftentimes fatal.

**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services.

* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]

* Pharmacotherapeutics

* Chemotherapy

treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

Hello! I’m Praminda Jayawardana,

Over the past decade, I’ve engineered API managers and gateways, authentication frameworks, data
pipelines, AI integrated services, and other distributed services handling millions of requests per
hour.

Recently, I’ve been exploring AI technologies and Web3, intrigued by their potential to build
systems more efficiently and secure them with transparency.

## Projects
* [API][1]
* [AI][2]
* [Auth][3]
* [Data][4]
* [Mobile][5]
* [All][6]

### Plugable Semantic/Lexical Search Service

Product Owner | Lead Engineer

A semantic and lexical search engine for indexing and retrieving context-aware results from large
volumes of structured and unstructured data. It supports complex queries with filters using vector
similarity and lexical similarity, and can provide context-aware answers to questions based on
search results. Data is ingested from sources like S3 buckets and websites. Then cleaned, chunked
and optimized before creating embeddings for semantic search (RAG pipeline).

Key challenges included achieving indexing time of 1 million records in under 2 hours and delivering
search results with AI-powered answers within 500ms. The solution involved trying out different
transformers, distance types, and index types, as well as reranking results and providing
configurable indexing options depending on the source data and customer requirements.

**Key responsibilities:**
* Led the design and implementation of data ingestion pipelines, document transformation processes,
  and indexing workflows.
* Developed semantic search APIs enabling flexible querying with metadata filters.
* Developed semantic, lexical search and AI answer features on top of GDN features.
* Contributed to and reviewed the React-based GUI console for configuring and testing indexing and
  search functionalities.

**Languages**: `Python`, `React`
**Tools**:
* `Macrometa GDN` – Data store, Vector store and underlying search provider
* `FastAPI` – HTTP framework and the interface to the users
* `Docker & Kubernetes` – For deployment and scaling, including the production environments
* `GitHub Actions` + `Argo` – CI and CD

### GUI QA Agent

Lead Engineer

An AI agent designed to automate web GUI testing and reduce repetitive QA work on frontend
applications. Built as a Crew AI multi-agent system, it interprets feature requirements and QA
scenarios, then generates Cypress tests. The process starts by providing clear test documentation
and a live app URL to `browser-use`, which identifies the necessary actions. Another agent then
converts these steps into a Cypress test suite.

**Key responsibilities:**
* Led and developed this tool as part of a broader framework for automating QA, collaborating with
  other team members on the overall system.

**Languages**: `Python`
**Tools**:
* `Browser-Use` – External API contract design and validation
* `CrewAI` - Multi agent framework

### Choreo Connect Microgateway

Tech Lead

A cloud-native API gateway for microservices. Choreo Connect separates control and data planes for
scalability, security, and performance. It supports dynamic configuration via gRPC-based xDS
protocol, OpenAPI definitions, and integrates with WSO2 Choreo. Features include authentication,
rate-limiting, observability, analytics, and distributed tracing. The gateway reliably handled ~3000
transactions per second with latency under 250ms for 1000 concurrent users on constrained hardware
(1 CPU, 512MB memory).

**Key responsibilities:**
* One of the founding engineers
* Contributed to architecting the core product with scalability, performance, runtime mutability,
  and ease of maintenance as primary goals.
* Led the control plane development in Go.
* Contributed to the data plane in Java; filter chain implementation, authentication, and
  observability using Envoy ext_auth filter.

**Languages**: `Go`, `Java`, `Protobuf`
**Tools**:
* `gRPC + xDS Protocol` – to stream API and routing configurations from control plane to gateway in
  real time
* `OpenAPI` – for defining API structure and generating gateway configs
* `Kubernetes` – for deployment orchestration and service mesh integration
* `Prometheus` – for gateway telemetry and monitoring
* `Jaeger` – for distributed tracing
* `OAuth2/JWT` – for authentication and policy enforcement
* `Envoy` – as the base TCP proxy to implement gateway filter chain
* `GitHub Actions` – for CI/CD automation and test pipelines

Tech Lead

A cloud-native, developer-centric API gateway for microservices that simplifies composing, securing,

A semantic and lexical search engine for indexing and retrieving context-aware results from large
volumes of structured and unstructured data. It supports complex queries with filters using vector
similarity and lexical similarity, and can provide context-aware answers to questions based on
search results. Data is ingested from sources like S3 buckets and websites. Then cleaned, chunked

transformers, distance types, and index types, as well as reranking results and providing

One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren
leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

Ganz gleich, ob Sie die BFS-Technologie ohne großes Investitionsrisiko testen möchten,
Produktionsspitzen abdecken oder Marktchargen vollständig produzieren wollen – unsere
**[Lohnabfüllung][44] **bietet Ihnen modernste Anlagen und ein umfassendes Servicepaket zu äußerst
wettbewerbsfähigen Preisen.

Zudem bietet unser erfahrenes Team umfassende Unterstützung bei der **Entwicklung **und Optimierung
Ihres Produkts für die Blow-Fill-Seal-Technologie.

enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# Leading Global Pharmaceutical Company

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is committed to being the world’s leading manufacturer and
exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## We are offering
## best Services & Products

High-quality pharmaceutical, ayurvedic, and antibiotic medications are available from Salvavidas
Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while
offering reasonably priced goods that benefit both patients and society as a whole.

## We Committed for a Better Life

### Salvavidas pharma is a leading pharmaceutical manufacturing and export company in India

We place a high priority on customer happiness, which we accomplish by offering high-quality
medicines on schedule and at fair prices. We promise that every product meets the highest caliber
throughout its development, manufacturing, sale, distribution, etc. We are dedicated to establishing
and preserving solid bonds with our clients worldwide. As a result, we are now recognized as a
reliable exporter offering service globally.

## What we bring to you

Salvavidas Pharma is a well-known Indian pharmaceutical exporter that provides a wide variety of
medications to international markets. The organization, which is based in Surat, Gujarat, is one of
the greatest places to find pharmaceutical items. It provides a wide range of products that are
developed to fulfill the requirements of its customers, such as antimalarials, analgesics, and
antibiotics. Salvavidas Pharma, which has a large worldwide presence, focuses on public health as a
driver for social and economic advancement. It is currently one of the leading pharmaceutical firms
in India. 

[Manufacturing and Export Company][Manufacturing and Export Company]

## Worldwide Reach

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. exports to more than 40 nations across five continents: Africa,
South-East Asia, Latin America, North America, and the CIS region. We are an Indian manufacturer and
exporter of all pharmaceutical items with more than 500 product registrations worldwide.

# Leading Global Pharmaceutical Company

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is committed to being the world’s leading manufacturer and
exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## We are offering
## best Services & Products

High-quality pharmaceutical, ayurvedic, and antibiotic medications are available from Salvavidas
Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while
offering reasonably priced goods that benefit both patients and society as a whole.

medicines on schedule and at fair prices. We promise that every product meets the highest caliber
throughout its development, manufacturing, sale, distribution, etc. We are dedicated to establishing
and preserving solid bonds with our clients worldwide. As a result, we are now recognized as a
reliable exporter offering service globally.

## What we bring to you

Salvavidas Pharma is a well-known Indian pharmaceutical exporter that provides a wide variety of
medications to international markets. The organization, which is based in Surat, Gujarat, is one of
the greatest places to find pharmaceutical items. It provides a wide range of products that are
developed to fulfill the requirements of its customers, such as antimalarials, analgesics, and
antibiotics. Salvavidas Pharma, which has a large worldwide presence, focuses on public health as a
driver for social and economic advancement. It is currently one of the leading pharmaceutical firms
in India.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

Environmental, Social, and Governance

## We Create Lasting Solutions
## That Drive Change

Our ESG commitment shapes how we develop, manufacture, and deliver active pharmaceutical ingredients
(APIs) and CDMO services, with a long-term view toward shared value and global well-being.

[Learn More][112]
Environmental

### Sustainable Practices for a Greener Future

We are committed to minimizing our environmental footprint by integrating eco-conscious practices
into our production and supply chain. From investing in energy-efficient technologies to reducing
water usage and chemical waste, we actively pursue greener processes without compromising quality or
compliance.

Governance

### Integrity and Accountability in Action

We maintain rigorous compliance standards, transparent reporting, and ethical business practices
across our global operations. From quality control to cybersecurity, our governance framework
ensures accountability and risk management at every level.

Social

### Empowering Communities and People Wordwide

People are at the heart of everything we do, and we collaborate with our partners and communities to
promote health, education, and opportunity. Ethical labor practices, ongoing workforce development,
and a commitment to health equity are key pillars of our social impact strategy.

Our ESG commitment shapes how we develop, manufacture, and deliver active pharmaceutical ingredients
(APIs) and CDMO services, with a long-term view toward shared value and global well-being.

Environmental

### Sustainable Practices for a Greener Future

We are committed to minimizing our environmental footprint by integrating eco-conscious practices
into our production and supply chain. From investing in energy-efficient technologies to reducing
water usage and chemical waste, we actively pursue greener processes without compromising quality or
compliance.

Governance

### Integrity and Accountability in Action

We maintain rigorous compliance standards, transparent reporting, and ethical business practices
across our global operations. From quality control to cybersecurity, our governance framework
ensures accountability and risk management at every level.

Social

### Empowering Communities and People Wordwide

People are at the heart of everything we do, and we collaborate with our partners and communities to
promote health, education, and opportunity. Ethical labor practices, ongoing workforce development,
and a commitment to health equity are key pillars of our social impact strategy.

If you’ve ever been frustrated by Roblox crashing mid-game, forced updates wiping your settings, or
just wanting more control over how you play — you’re not alone. That’s exactly the problem Bloxstrap
was built to solve.

Bloxstrap is a free, open-source alternative bootstrapper for Roblox on Windows. Think of it as a
smarter, more powerful replacement for the default Roblox launcher — one that gives you full control
over your game, your mods, your FPS, and your overall experience. Since its release by developer
Pizzaboxer, it has become the go-to choice for hundreds of thousands of Roblox players worldwide who
want a smoother, safer, and more personalized experience.

## What is Bloxstrap?

At its core, Bloxstrap is a drop-in replacement for the standard Roblox bootstrapper. When you
launch Roblox through Bloxstrap, you get access to a whole suite of features that the official
launcher simply doesn’t offer — from custom mods and advanced graphics settings to Discord
integration and multi-instance support.

What makes Bloxstrap stand out is how it handles updates. The official Roblox launcher is notorious
for wiping custom settings and mods every time it updates. Bloxstrap solves this by keeping your
customizations separate, so your themes, mods, and even custom [fonts for Bloxstrap][11] stay
exactly where you left them — even after a Roblox update.

It’s worth noting that Bloxstrap only modifies how Roblox launches on your PC. It does not touch the
game’s actual files or servers, which means your account remains completely safe.

If you’ve ever been frustrated by Roblox crashing mid-game, forced updates wiping your settings, or
just wanting more control over how you play — you’re not alone. That’s exactly the problem Bloxstrap
was built to solve.

Bloxstrap is a free, open-source alternative bootstrapper for Roblox on Windows. Think of it as a
smarter, more powerful replacement for the default Roblox launcher — one that gives you full control
over your game, your mods, your FPS, and your overall experience. Since its release by developer
Pizzaboxer, it has become the go-to choice for hundreds of thousands of Roblox players worldwide who
want a smoother, safer, and more personalized experience.

## What is Bloxstrap?

At its core, Bloxstrap is a drop-in replacement for the standard Roblox bootstrapper. When you
launch Roblox through Bloxstrap, you get access to a whole suite of features that the official
launcher simply doesn’t offer — from custom mods and advanced graphics settings to Discord
integration and multi-instance support.

What makes Bloxstrap stand out is how it handles updates. The official Roblox launcher is notorious
for wiping custom settings and mods every time it updates. Bloxstrap solves this by keeping your
customizations separate, so your themes, mods, and even custom [fonts for Bloxstrap][11] stay
exactly where you left them — even after a Roblox update.

It’s worth noting that Bloxstrap only modifies how Roblox launches on your PC. It does not touch the
game’s actual files or servers, which means your account remains completely safe.

## Why Thousands of Players Choose Bloxstrap

The official Roblox launcher works fine for casual players. But if you care about performance,
customization, or just want a more stable experience, the default launcher falls short in several
key areas:
* It forces updates that reset your mod settings
* It doesn’t support running multiple Roblox instances at once
* There’s no built-in Discord integration
* Graphics settings are limited to basic controls
* You have no control over which server region you connect to

Bloxstrap addresses every single one of these pain points. Here’s a closer look at what it brings to
the table.

## Key Features of Bloxstrap

### **FPS Unlocker**

By default, Roblox caps your frame rate at 60 FPS. Bloxstrap removes this cap entirely, letting your
game run at the full refresh rate of your monitor — whether that’s 144Hz, 165Hz, or higher. For
competitive players, this alone is a game-changer.

### Custom MODs

Bloxstrap gives you a dedicated mod manager where you can add custom sounds, fonts, cursors, and
visual themes. Unlike other mod tools, your changes are preserved after every Roblox update. You can
bring back the classic “oof” death sound, swap in a retro cursor, or completely overhaul the look of
your launcher — all without touching the actual game files.

### **FastFlag Editor**

FastFlags are internal Roblox settings that control everything from graphics rendering to
experimental features. Bloxstrap exposes these flags through a clean, user-friendly editor. You can
boost performance on low-end PCs, fix visual bugs, or enable features that aren’t available in the
standard launcher. Just be careful — some flags are best left to experienced users.

### **Discord-rich Presence**

With Bloxstrap’s built-in Discord integration, your current game, server, and status automatically
appear on your Discord profile. Friends can see exactly what you’re playing and even click to join
you directly — no copying and pasting game links required.

### **Multiple Instances**

Want to test a game while playing another? Or manage multiple Roblox accounts at the same time?
Bloxstrap makes multi-instance launching straightforward. Run as many Roblox windows as your PC can
handle, all independently managed.

### **Server Region Checker**

Ever wonder why you’re lagging even with a fast internet connection? You might be connected to a
far-away server. Bloxstrap’s region checker shows you exactly which server you’re on and lets you
switch to a region with better ping in seconds.

### **UI and Appearance Customization**

Bloxstrap lets you fully customize the look of your Roblox launcher. Change the theme between
classic 2015-era menus and the latest modern design, adjust font sizes, remove the full-screen title
bar, and fine-tune graphics with 21 quality levels instead of the default 10.

### **Activity Tracker**

The activity tracker keeps a log of your play sessions — which games you played, for how long, and
on which servers. It’s especially useful if you tend to lose track of time, or if you’re a developer
who needs to monitor specific game sessions.

### **Safe and Open-Source**

Bloxstrap’s entire source code is publicly available on GitHub. This means security researchers,
developers, and anyone who’s curious can review exactly what the software does. There’s no hidden
code, no spyware, and no risk to your Roblox account. It’s trusted by hundreds of thousands of
players, parents, and even schools.

## How to Download and Install Bloxstrap on Windows

Getting Bloxstrap up and running takes less than five minutes. Follow these steps carefully for a
smooth installation.

### **Step 1: Download the Installer**

Click the Download button on this page to get the latest Bloxstrap installer. Always download from
this page to avoid tampered or modified versions.

### **Step 2: Install .NET Desktop Runtime (If Needed)**

Bloxstrap requires .NET Desktop Runtime to work. If you don’t have it installed, Bloxstrap will
prompt you automatically. Just click “Yes” and it will download and install on its own. Once done,
find the setup file in your Downloads folder and run it.

### **Step 3: Run the Bloxstrap Installer**

Once .NET is ready, double-click the Bloxstrap installer. You’ll be guided through a short setup
process:
* Choose your preferred language
* Select an install location (the default works fine for most users)
* Decide whether you want a desktop shortcut
* Click “Install” to finish

### **Step 4: Launch and Configure**

After installation, Bloxstrap will open automatically. From here, you can explore the Mods tab to
add custom content, the FastFlags section for advanced tweaks, and the Integrations tab to set up
Discord Rich Presence. Once you’re happy with your settings, hit “Save and Launch” to start Roblox.

## How to Use Bloxstrap
* **Step 1 — Open Bloxstrap** Launch it from your desktop shortcut or Start menu. It automatically

* **Step 2 — Set Your Appearance** Head to the Appearance tab to pick a theme and adjust how your
  launcher looks.
* **Step 3 — Configure Launch Options** In Launch Options, set your preferred startup behavior —
  whether that’s launching straight into a game or opening the menu first.

* [About Us ][79]
  Corporate overview 25 years of digital excellence Global locations Awards and recognition Client
  speak Social responsibility Partnership & alliance
  
  ### Enabling digital business transformation through integrated ecosystems.
  
  We nurture lasting relationships, enabling stronger teams, bold and intelligent decisions, better
  products and services. 
  
  [Know more][80]
  
  ### Pioneering the digital ecosystem landscape for 25 years
  
  For over 25 years, Torry Harris' focus on integration solutions has fostered seamless digital
  connectivity, enabling better and faster commerce for businesses through platform business models.
  
  [Know more][81]
  
  ### Our global presence
  
  From innovation hubs to delivery centers, we bring the right people, skills, and technology
  together to support your digital transformation journey.
  
  [Know more][82]
  
  ### Excellence milestones
  
  Our relentless focus on excellence has earned us prestigious awards and recognition across various
  domains. Learn about our achievements.
  
  [Know more][83]
  
  ### What our clients say about us
  
  From enhancing customer experiences to optimizing complex integrations, we’re proud to be a
  trusted partner in helping organizations achieve their strategic goals. Explore our client
  transformation stories.
  
  [Know more][84]
  
  ### Building brighter futures
  
  Our WeCare initiative is more than just a program-it’s a promise to uplift and empower
   individuals who are often overlooked, helping them find a sense of purpose, self-worth, and
  economic independence. Whether through training, collaboration with social enterprises, or
  providing direct support, we work to ensure that dignity is restored and futures are reclaimed,
  one project at a time.
  
  [Know more][85]
  
  ### Delivering value through collaboration
  
  We believe that the right partnerships can make all the difference. Our strong partnerships enable
  us to deliver on our promise of high performance, flexibility, and competitive pricing, ensuring
  that our customers achieve their strategic objectives with confidence.
  
  [Know more][86]

# Capsules & Health Ingredients

As a global leader in capsule design, manufacturing and encapsulation technology, we are dedicated
to create customized solutions that help you deliver groundbreaking health products to the market.

Backed by an ecosystem of technological insights, world class manufacturing, scientific expertise
and process excellence, we can support your brand throughout the entire development lifecycle.

#### We are capsule and health ingredients experts

Powered by industry-leading technologies, science-backed ingredients and a rich history in the
pharmaceutical and nutraceutical markets, we are more than just our products. We are capsule
experts, ingredient scientists and manufacturers with a solutions-focused mindset and we have been
helping brands overcome challenges for more than 100 years.

We support brands with a broad range of hard empty capsules for the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical
industries, including clean label and plant-based alternatives, as well as innovative delivery
technologies.

In addition, we offer a range of science-backed specialty health ingredients. Fueled by
consumer-centric data, our ingredients enable brands to disrupt the nutraceutical market with
purposeful products for human and animal nutrition.

We are constantly evolving and innovating to help you deliver products that meet in-demand patient
and consumer needs, as well as key market trends. Our concept-to-market services can assist you in
designing, optimizing and manufacturing your unique dosage forms that meet evolving patient and
consumer requirements.

#### Our difference

We are the preferred partner for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical companies around the world.
Helping you to create purpose-led, market-disrupting products with a competitive edge requires a
deep commitment to excellence. We are dedicated to adding value to your brand at every stage of your
development process, from concept to consumer.

[woman holding capsule]
* 1970
  
  We introduced the most popular two-piece hard gelatin capsule in the world - Capsugel® Coni-Snap®
  Hard Gelatin Capsule. This technology is a patented, two-ring closure system facilitating
  high-speed filling processing and secure locking of capsule body and cap.
* 1985
  
  Our portfolio of premium grade L-carnitine ingredients began with the launch of Carnipure®
  L-carnitine crystalline, which accelerated research and development behind the important benefits
  of L-carnitine for human and animal health.
* 1986
  
  ChromeMate® niacin-bound chromium complex was launched, offering nutraceutical brands an
  opportunity to create science-backed solutions that help to maintain healthy cholesterol levels
  and support weight management.
* 1990
  
  Carnipure® L-carnitine tartrate was introduced into the nutraceutical market and the first human
  clinical trials were initiated, leading to groundbreaking new insights behind the role of
  L-carnitine in supporting exercise recovery.
* 1993
  
  Our journey exploring science-backed solutions to meet the needs of the pet and production animal
  markets began with the launch of Carniking® L-carnitine for pet health.
* 1997
  
  Super CitriMax® 60% HCA was launched into the nutraceutical market, offering brands a unique
  solution for satiety and appetite.
* 1998
  
  We transformed the pharmaceutical industry with the introduction of our DBCaps® over-encapsulation
  capsules. This is a double-blind solution with a tamper-evident design, addressing the clinical
  trial challenge of testing without bias.
* 2000
  
  Capsugel® Licaps® liquid-filled capsules were launched into the nutraceutical market with a
  revolutionary capsule sealing and fusion technology. This technology is specifically designed to
  encapsulate liquid-based and specialty powder formulations.
  
  In the same year, we brought our L-Optizinc® zinc mono-L-methionine sulfate ingredient to market,
  offering superior absorption, retention and antioxidant properties over other forms of zinc.
* 2001
  
  UC-II® undenatured type II collagen was launched, marking the beginning of its successful journey
  as a unique joint health ingredient, available for clinical trial investigation.
* 2008
  
  ResistAid® arabinogalactan was launched, making the unique immune health benefits of this
  ingredient available to brands in the nutraceutical market.
* 2009
  
  The gold standard in HPMC capsules was introduced — Capsugel® Vcaps® Plus HPMC capsules. This
  capsule is produced by specifically developed thermo-gelation processes, without the addition of
  gelling systems.
* 2011
  
  We introduced our DRcaps® designed release capsules. Created to protect sensitive ingredients like
  probiotics against stomach acid and release them at the right time and in the right location in
  the body, this capsule polymer allows brands to create more advanced products that target diverse
  health areas.
  
  We transformed the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical market through Plantcaps® pullulan capsules—a
  plant-based vegetarian alternative. This groundbreaking solution enables brands to meet the
  preferences of environmentally-conscious consumers and patients.
* 2015
  
  We streamlined the capsule manufacturing filling process with the launch of Ultra III®, a
  high-speed, semi-automatic filling machine, providing drug developers with an innovative and
  flexible solution to meet a wide array of filling requirements.
* 2016
  
  The first customer commercialized our proprietary lipid multi-particulate technology,
  strengthening our positioning as an industry-leading partner in the nutraceutical and
  pharmaceutical markets.
* 2017
  
  We purchased Capsugel and InterHealth to create a leading integrated solutions provider to the
  global pharma and consumer healthcare industries.
* 2019
  
  In response to changing regulations and consumer demand for an alternative solution, we created
  the Vcaps® Plus White Opal® capsule. This is a titanium dioxide-free, white colored capsule that
  is suitable for vegan and vegetarian diets, as well as being allergen and gluten-free.
* 2020
  
  The Lonza Engine® Alliance Program was launched. This is our partnership with some of the world’s
  leading equipment manufacturers, where we offer reliable powder-filling equipment, plus
  world-class service and support capabilities.

# Capsules & Health Ingredients

As a global leader in capsule design, manufacturing and encapsulation technology, we are dedicated
to create customized solutions that help you deliver groundbreaking health products to the market.

Backed by an ecosystem of technological insights, world class manufacturing, scientific expertise
and process excellence, we can support your brand throughout the entire development lifecycle.

#### We are capsule and health ingredients experts

Powered by industry-leading technologies, science-backed ingredients and a rich history in the
pharmaceutical and nutraceutical markets, we are more than just our products. We are capsule
experts, ingredient scientists and manufacturers with a solutions-focused mindset and we have been
helping brands overcome challenges for more than 100 years.

We support brands with a broad range of hard empty capsules for the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical
industries, including clean label and plant-based alternatives, as well as innovative delivery
technologies.

In addition, we offer a range of science-backed specialty health ingredients. Fueled by
consumer-centric data, our ingredients enable brands to disrupt the nutraceutical market with
purposeful products for human and animal nutrition.

We are constantly evolving and innovating to help you deliver products that meet in-demand patient
and consumer needs, as well as key market trends. Our concept-to-market services can assist you in
designing, optimizing and manufacturing your unique dosage forms that meet evolving patient and
consumer requirements.

#### Our difference

We are the preferred partner for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical companies around the world.
Helping you to create purpose-led, market-disrupting products with a competitive edge requires a
deep commitment to excellence. We are dedicated to adding value to your brand at every stage of your
development process, from concept to consumer.

* 1970
  
  We introduced the most popular two-piece hard gelatin capsule in the world - Capsugel® Coni-Snap®
  Hard Gelatin Capsule. This technology is a patented, two-ring closure system facilitating
  high-speed filling processing and secure locking of capsule body and cap.
* 1985
  
  Our portfolio of premium grade L-carnitine ingredients began with the launch of Carnipure®
  L-carnitine crystalline, which accelerated research and development behind the important benefits
  of L-carnitine for human and animal health.
* 1986
  
  ChromeMate® niacin-bound chromium complex was launched, offering nutraceutical brands an
  opportunity to create science-backed solutions that help to maintain healthy cholesterol levels
  and support weight management.
* 1990
  
  Carnipure® L-carnitine tartrate was introduced into the nutraceutical market and the first human
  clinical trials were initiated, leading to groundbreaking new insights behind the role of
  L-carnitine in supporting exercise recovery.
* 1993
  
  Our journey exploring science-backed solutions to meet the needs of the pet and production animal
  markets began with the launch of Carniking® L-carnitine for pet health.
* 1997
  
  Super CitriMax® 60% HCA was launched into the nutraceutical market, offering brands a unique
  solution for satiety and appetite.
* 1998
  
  We transformed the pharmaceutical industry with the introduction of our DBCaps® over-encapsulation
  capsules. This is a double-blind solution with a tamper-evident design, addressing the clinical
  trial challenge of testing without bias.
* 2000
  
  Capsugel® Licaps® liquid-filled capsules were launched into the nutraceutical market with a
  revolutionary capsule sealing and fusion technology. This technology is specifically designed to
  encapsulate liquid-based and specialty powder formulations.
  
  In the same year, we brought our L-Optizinc® zinc mono-L-methionine sulfate ingredient to market,
  offering superior absorption, retention and antioxidant properties over other forms of zinc.
* 2001
  
  UC-II® undenatured type II collagen was launched, marking the beginning of its successful journey
  as a unique joint health ingredient, available for clinical trial investigation.
* 2008
  
  ResistAid® arabinogalactan was launched, making the unique immune health benefits of this
  ingredient available to brands in the nutraceutical market.
* 2009
  
  The gold standard in HPMC capsules was introduced — Capsugel® Vcaps® Plus HPMC capsules. This
  capsule is produced by specifically developed thermo-gelation processes, without the addition of
  gelling systems.
* 2011
  
  We introduced our DRcaps® designed release capsules. Created to protect sensitive ingredients like
  probiotics against stomach acid and release them at the right time and in the right location in
  the body, this capsule polymer allows brands to create more advanced products that target diverse
  health areas.
  
  We transformed the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical market through Plantcaps® pullulan capsules—a
  plant-based vegetarian alternative. This groundbreaking solution enables brands to meet the
  preferences of environmentally-conscious consumers and patients.
* 2015
  
  We streamlined the capsule manufacturing filling process with the launch of Ultra III®, a
  high-speed, semi-automatic filling machine, providing drug developers with an innovative and
  flexible solution to meet a wide array of filling requirements.
* 2016
  
  The first customer commercialized our proprietary lipid multi-particulate technology,
  strengthening our positioning as an industry-leading partner in the nutraceutical and
  pharmaceutical markets.
* 2017
  
  We purchased Capsugel and InterHealth to create a leading integrated solutions provider to the
  global pharma and consumer healthcare industries.
* 2019
  
  In response to changing regulations and consumer demand for an alternative solution, we created
  the Vcaps® Plus White Opal® capsule. This is a titanium dioxide-free, white colored capsule that
  is suitable for vegan and vegetarian diets, as well as being allergen and gluten-free.
* 2020
  
  The Lonza Engine® Alliance Program was launched. This is our partnership with some of the world’s
  leading equipment manufacturers, where we offer reliable powder-filling equipment, plus
  world-class service and support capabilities.

## Migrate, Modernize, & Transform Any Workload, Across Any Environment.

Most teams are running VMs, containers, and AI workloads across separate stacks while navigating
VMware price spikes, the Ingress NGINX retirement, and ungoverned AI. Traefik helps you address all
this with a single, lightweight binary.
* Migrate
* Modernize
* Transform

Migrate

## Move Workloads, Not Risk.

Whether you're escaping VMware licensing, replacing Ingress NGINX, or switching cloud providers,
Traefik is the safe landing.

[Explore][96]
* ### VMware Migration, On Your Timeline
  
  One unified gateway governs your VM workloads across any environment. Migrate to any hypervisor or
  container without changing policies.
* ### Ingress NGINX Migration, Zero Configuration
  
  90%+ of real-world Ingress NGINX annotations are supported natively. Bring your existing YAML,
  enable the provider, & ship. No rewrite required.
* ### WAF Protection, Continued
  
  ModSecurity support preserves your Ingress NGINX WAF behavior during migration for security parity
  from day one.

Modernize

## Use One Gateway for VMs, Containers, and APIs

Stop running three control planes. Govern Kubernetes workloads, VM-based services, and any APIs,
including AI endpoints, through one programmable and declarative gateway.

[Explore][97]
* ### Kubernetes-Native, Actually
  
  Traefik is the default ingress in NKP, RKE2, K3s, IKS, MicroK8s, & more; validated with top
  NeoClouds; & has full Gateway API & Ingress support. Deployed on-prem or with any hyperscaler,
  with the same control plane everywhere.
* ### VMs & Containers, Side by Side
  
  Most teams run both, so Traefik fronts VMs & Kubernetes simultaneously, all with the same routes,
  auth policies, & observability, so both modernized & legacy workloads are governed via a single
  control plane.
* ### API Management, Built-In
  
  API catalog, lifecycle, dev portal, & multi-cluster federation are all in one governed surface.
  OpenAPI schema validation is enforced at the gateway, so undocumented paths & malformed payloads
  are rejected before reaching services.

Transform

## Govern AI and APIs via the Same Control Plane

Agents, models, and MCP traffic need runtime governance like APIs, but with specialized controls
only a unified gateway can optimally enforce.

[Explore][98]
* ### Triple Gate Architecture, in One
  
  Traefik’s API Gateway, AI Gateway, & MCP Gateway are rolled into a single binary, so the same auth
  & observability that fronts your microservices also fronts your model & agentic traffic.
* ### Cost & Safety Governed, at Runtime
  
  Token rate limits & content guardrails are enforced before requests reach your models.
  Burst-tolerant token limits & parallel inspection ensure defense-in-depth without added latency.
* ### Agent-Aware Refusals, by Default
  
  Structured refusals are returned in the format the client expects: Chat Completions, Responses
  API, Messages API, raw text, or custom. Agents handle blocked requests as control flow, not a
  crash.

## One Binary. Six Dimensions. Zero Lock-In.

All six share the same declarative config model, governance as a first-class primitive, and a
unified control plane. Start with Proxy and add capabilities seamlessly when you're ready. Same
routes. No rewrites.
* [Routing & Traffic]
  
  ### Routing & Traffic
  
  Dynamic L4/L7 routing, traffic shifting, canaries, blue/green, request mirroring, & retry/failover
  across VMs & containers.
  * HTTP/2, HTTP/3, gRPC
  * TCP / UDP / mTLS
  * Weighted + header-based routing
* [Auth & Policy]
  
  ### Auth & Policy
  
  OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, OPA-compatible authorization at the edge. Rate limits, quotas, & header
  transformations included.
  * IdP-agnostic
  * Per-route policy
  * Fine-grained authZ
* [Observability]
  
  ### Observability
  
  First-class OpenTelemetry: metrics, traces, & structured access logs with OTel-conformant trace
  context. Correlate gateway & service behavior in one pane.
  * OTel native
  * Streaming OTLP + stdio access logs
  * Any observability tool (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Dash0, etc.)
* [API Management]
  
  ### API Management
  
  Catalog, lifecycle, versioning, & developer portal for internal & external APIs. Multi-cluster
  federation brings them into a single governed surface.
  * API catalog + portal
  * OpenAPI schema validation at the gateway
  * Multi-cluster federation
* [AI Governance]
  
  ### AI Governance
  
  One gateway for every model creates consistent auth, token metering, & prompt safety. Reject
  oversized or over-budget prompts before they reach the model.
  * AI Token Rate Limit & Quota
  * Parallel LLM Guard middleware
  * Content Guard Regex & NLP Engine
* [MCP Governance]
  
  ### MCP Governance
  
  Govern MCP traffic the way you govern APIs. Discoverable, observable, & policy-bound from day one,
  where refusals are returned as control flow, not crashes.
  * MCP server registry
  * TBAC for per-tool & per-task AuthZ
  * Observability for Audit + replay

## Migrate, Modernize, & Transform Any Workload, Across Any Environment.

Most teams are running VMs, containers, and AI workloads across separate stacks while navigating
VMware price spikes, the Ingress NGINX retirement, and ungoverned AI. Traefik helps you address all
this with a single, lightweight binary.
* Migrate
* Modernize
* Transform

Migrate

## Move Workloads, Not Risk.

Whether you're escaping VMware licensing, replacing Ingress NGINX, or switching cloud providers,
Traefik is the safe landing.

[Explore][96]
* ### VMware Migration, On Your Timeline
  
  One unified gateway governs your VM workloads across any environment. Migrate to any hypervisor or
  container without changing policies.
* ### Ingress NGINX Migration, Zero Configuration
  
  90%+ of real-world Ingress NGINX annotations are supported natively. Bring your existing YAML,
  enable the provider, & ship. No rewrite required.
* ### WAF Protection, Continued
  
  ModSecurity support preserves your Ingress NGINX WAF behavior during migration for security parity
  from day one.

Modernize

## Use One Gateway for VMs, Containers, and APIs

Stop running three control planes. Govern Kubernetes workloads, VM-based services, and any APIs,
including AI endpoints, through one programmable and declarative gateway.

[Explore][97]
* ### Kubernetes-Native, Actually
  
  Traefik is the default ingress in NKP, RKE2, K3s, IKS, MicroK8s, & more; validated with top
  NeoClouds; & has full Gateway API & Ingress support. Deployed on-prem or with any hyperscaler,
  with the same control plane everywhere.
* ### VMs & Containers, Side by Side
  
  Most teams run both, so Traefik fronts VMs & Kubernetes simultaneously, all with the same routes,
  auth policies, & observability, so both modernized & legacy workloads are governed via a single
  control plane.
* ### API Management, Built-In
  
  API catalog, lifecycle, dev portal, & multi-cluster federation are all in one governed surface.
  OpenAPI schema validation is enforced at the gateway, so undocumented paths & malformed payloads
  are rejected before reaching services.

Transform

## Govern AI and APIs via the Same Control Plane

Agents, models, and MCP traffic need runtime governance like APIs, but with specialized controls
only a unified gateway can optimally enforce.

[Explore][98]
* ### Triple Gate Architecture, in One
  
  Traefik’s API Gateway, AI Gateway, & MCP Gateway are rolled into a single binary, so the same auth
  & observability that fronts your microservices also fronts your model & agentic traffic.
* ### Cost & Safety Governed, at Runtime
  
  Token rate limits & content guardrails are enforced before requests reach your models.
  Burst-tolerant token limits & parallel inspection ensure defense-in-depth without added latency.
* ### Agent-Aware Refusals, by Default
  
  Structured refusals are returned in the format the client expects: Chat Completions, Responses
  API, Messages API, raw text, or custom. Agents handle blocked requests as control flow, not a
  crash.

## One Binary. Six Dimensions. Zero Lock-In.

All six share the same declarative config model, governance as a first-class primitive, and a
unified control plane. Start with Proxy and add capabilities seamlessly when you're ready. Same
routes. No rewrites.
* [Routing & Traffic]
  
  ### Routing & Traffic
  
  Dynamic L4/L7 routing, traffic shifting, canaries, blue/green, request mirroring, & retry/failover
  across VMs & containers.
  * HTTP/2, HTTP/3, gRPC
  * TCP / UDP / mTLS
  * Weighted + header-based routing
* [Auth & Policy]
  
  ### Auth & Policy
  
  OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, OPA-compatible authorization at the edge. Rate limits, quotas, & header
  transformations included.
  * IdP-agnostic
  * Per-route policy
  * Fine-grained authZ
* [Observability]
  
  ### Observability
  
  First-class OpenTelemetry: metrics, traces, & structured access logs with OTel-conformant trace
  context. Correlate gateway & service behavior in one pane.
  * OTel native
  * Streaming OTLP + stdio access logs
  * Any observability tool (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Dash0, etc.)
* [API Management]
  
  ### API Management
  
  Catalog, lifecycle, versioning, & developer portal for internal & external APIs. Multi-cluster
  federation brings them into a single governed surface.
  * API catalog + portal
  * OpenAPI schema validation at the gateway
  * Multi-cluster federation
* [AI Governance]
  
  ### AI Governance
  
  One gateway for every model creates consistent auth, token metering, & prompt safety. Reject
  oversized or over-budget prompts before they reach the model.
  * AI Token Rate Limit & Quota
  * Parallel LLM Guard middleware
  * Content Guard Regex & NLP Engine
* [MCP Governance]
  
  ### MCP Governance
  
  Govern MCP traffic the way you govern APIs. Discoverable, observable, & policy-bound from day one,
  where refusals are returned as control flow, not crashes.
  * MCP server registry
  * TBAC for per-tool & per-task AuthZ
  * Observability for Audit + replay

## What Users Have to Say.

When you're managing authentication and API access across 80 companies with different identity
providers, you need a solution that's both flexible and robust. This is why we chose Traefik Hub.
The API management layer with operation sets, managed subscriptions, and configuration as code gave
us the tools to properly govern who can see and consume our APIs at scale

Patrick Fink, Director Platform & Data, Ippen Digital

Traefik has been a game-changer for us. Its ease of configuration, scalability, and seamless support
have exceeded our expectations. Traefik is a strategic tool that has transformed how we manage
traffic across our infrastructure. I would highly recommend Traefik to any organization looking to
modernize their Kubernetes environment.

Sushant Gulati, Senior Engineering Manager, BigBasket

I would absolutely recommend Traefik's API gateway.

Thomas Ornell, Principal System Engineer, Abax

## FAQs about our invoicing and inventory management software

### Do I need to install Vencru's software?

Vencru is a cloud-based inventory and invoicing software that is accessible from any web browser.
You only need an internet connection to use it.

If you need an on-the-go solution, however, you can also download Vencru’s [mobile app][109] for
[iOS][110] or [Android][111] to manage invoices, inventory, and payments. You can also access the
[point of sale software][112] for each sales and stock tracking.

### How secure is Vencru?

Vencru takes security seriously. It utilizes 256-bit SSL encryption, deploys the application behind
firewalls, conducts vulnerability scanning, and follows secure development practices outlined by
OWASP. Regular penetration testing ensures ongoing security.

### Does Vencru provide customer support?

Yes, all Vencru’s inventory and billing software tiers include customer support. Depending on the
plan you choose, we provide different levels of support (email, phone, live demos). 

### Can I cancel my subscription for any reason?

Yes, you can unsubscribe at any time. The cancellation of your subscription will take effect at the
end of the billing period you canceled. Learn about our [subscription policy][113] and how to
[cancel your subscription][114] in our Help Center.

### Does Vencru support multiple businesses accounting

Vencru simplifies [bookkeeping for multi-entity][115] by providing a user-friendly platform for
essential tasks. It automates invoicing, tracks income and expenses, manages inventory levels, and
generates reports – all on one platform. Compare [options here][116].

Vencru is the simplest invoicing, accounting, and inventory software.

### Do I need to install Vencru's software?

Vencru is a cloud-based inventory and invoicing software that is accessible from any web browser.
You only need an internet connection to use it.

[point of sale software][112] for each sales and stock tracking.

### How secure is Vencru?

Vencru takes security seriously. It utilizes 256-bit SSL encryption, deploys the application behind
firewalls, conducts vulnerability scanning, and follows secure development practices outlined by
OWASP. Regular penetration testing ensures ongoing security.

### Does Vencru provide customer support?

Yes, all Vencru’s inventory and billing software tiers include customer support. Depending on the
plan you choose, we provide different levels of support (email, phone, live demos).

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
